author: blu
body: Colour anthem. Gauntlet of Might (ColorAnthem Red 1 1) pumps every red creature +1/+1, both players' -- symmetric like the real card. A 2/2 red Goblin becomes 3/3 while the Gauntlet is in play; a 2/2 green creature is unaffected; without the Gauntlet the Goblin is 2/2 again. Derived at read time and folded into effective P/T, gated to creatures.
